description_en: Queries the details about restoration tasks
description_zh: 查询防勒索恢复任务（即数据备份）的详情
name: DescribeRestoreJobs

parameters.help_en:
The status of the restoration task. Valid values:

RUNNING: The task is running.
COMPLETE: The task is complete.
FAILED: The task fails.
CANCELING: The task is being canceled.
CANCELED: The task is canceled.
PARTIAL_COMPLETE: The task is partially successful.
CREATED: The task is created but is not run.
EXPIRED: The task is not updated.
QUEUED: The task is waiting to be run.
CLIENT_DELETED: The task fails because the anti-ransomware agent is uninstalled
parameters.help_zh:
恢复状态。 取值：

RUNNING：恢复任务执行中
COMPLETE：恢复任务已完成
FAILED：恢复任务执行失败
CANCELING：恢复任务取消中
CANCELED：恢复任务已取消
PARTIAL_COMPLETE：恢复任务部分成功
CREATED：恢复任务已创建，但尚未开始启动
EXPIRED：恢复任务未更新
QUEUED：恢复任务在等待启动中
CLIENT_DELETED：防勒索客户端已被删除，任务执行失败
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the server on which the restoration task is run. For example, you can use the IP address or the name of the server
parameters.help_zh: 执行防勒索恢复任务的服务器的标识符，例如：服务器IP地址或服务器名称
parameters.name: machine_remark

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的恢复任务的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条恢复任务
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

PageInfo.description_zh: 页面上显示的查询结果信息

Count.description_en: The number of restoration tasks returned on the current page
Count.description_zh: 查询到的当前结果页面中恢复任务的条数

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned page
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page. Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的恢复任务的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条恢复任务

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of restoration tasks returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的恢复任务的总数量

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

RestoreJobs.description_en: The details about the restoration tasks

ActualBytes.description_en: The size of backup data. Unit: bytes
ActualBytes.description_zh: 备份文件的大小，单位为Bytes

BytesDone.description_en: The total size of data that is restored. Unit: bytes
BytesDone.description_zh: 成功恢复的数据总量，单位为Bytes

BytesTotal.description_en: The total size of data that you want to restore. Unit: bytes
BytesTotal.description_zh: 需要恢复的数据总量，单位为Bytes

ClientId.description_en: The ID of the anti-ransomware agent that is used to perform the restoration task

CompleteTime.description_en: The timestamp when the restoration task is complete. Unit: milliseconds
CompleteTime.description_zh: 恢复任务的完成时间戳，单位为毫秒

CreatedTime.description_en: The timestamp when the restoration task is created. Unit: milliseconds
CreatedTime.description_zh: 恢复任务的创建时间戳，单位为毫秒

Duration.description_en: The duration of the restoration task. Unit: seconds
Duration.description_zh: 恢复任务的持续时间，单位为秒

ErrorCount.description_en: The number of the restoration tasks on which errors occur
ErrorCount.description_zh: 报错的恢复任务的数量

ErrorFile.description_en: The name of the CSV file. The CSV file contains the files that fail to be restored
ErrorFile.description_zh: 恢复失败的文件列表的CSV文件名称

ErrorFileUrl.description_en: The URL to download the CSV file. The CSV file contains the files that fail to be restored
ErrorFileUrl.description_zh: 恢复任务失败的CSV文件下载的URL

ErrorType.description_en: The error code that is returned for the restoration task

Eta.description_en: The timestamp when the in-progress restoration task is expected to be complete. Unit: seconds
Eta.description_zh: 进行中的恢复任务的预计完成时间戳，单位为秒

Excludes.description_en: The directory excluded from the anti-ransomware policy. The value is the directory that you specify to skip protection when you create the anti-ransomware policy
Excludes.description_zh: 恢复文件中所排除的目录。该目录是在创建防勒索防护策略时指定的，即无需防护的目录

ExitCode.description_en: The return value of the restoration task

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the restoration task is created

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the restoration task is updated

Includes.description_en: The directory in which the restored file is stored. The value is the directory that you specify for protection when you create the anti-ransomware policy
Includes.description_zh: 恢复文件原所在的目录。该目录是在创建防勒索防护策略时指定的，即需要防护的目录

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the server whose data you want to restore
InstanceId.description_zh: 需要恢复数据的服务器的实例ID

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the server whose data you want to restore
InstanceName.description_zh: 需要恢复数据的服务器的名称

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address of the server whose data you want to restore
InternetIp.description_zh: 恢复数据的服务器的公网IP地址

IntranetIp.description_en: The internal IP address of the server whose data you want to restore
IntranetIp.description_zh: 需要恢复数据的服务器的内网IP地址

ItemsDone.description_en: The number of files that are restored
ItemsDone.description_zh: 成功恢复的文件的数量

ItemsTotal.description_en: The total number of files that need to be restored
ItemsTotal.description_zh: 需要恢复的文件的总数量

Percentage.description_en: The progress of the restoration task in percentage
Percentage.description_zh: 恢复任务的进度百分比

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

RestoreId.description_en: The ID of the restoration task

RestoreName.description_en: The name of the restoration task

RestoreType.description_en:
The type of the file that is restored. Valid values:

ECS_FILE: files on Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances
FILE: files on servers in data centers
RestoreType.description_zh:
恢复文件的类型。取值：

ECS_FILE：来自云服务器ECS的文件

FILE：来自本地主机文件

SnapshotHash.description_en: The hash value of the snapshot that stores backup data when the data is backed up
SnapshotHash.description_zh: 备份服务器数据时，存储备份数据的快照Hash值

SnapshotId.description_en: The hash value ID of the snapshot that stores backup data when the data is backed up
SnapshotId.description_zh: 备份服务器数据时，存储备份数据的快照Hash值ID

SnapshotVersion.description_en: The version of the backup data
SnapshotVersion.description_zh: 服务器数据的恢复版本（即备份版本）

SourceClientId.description_en: The ID of the anti-ransomware agent that is used to back up data
SourceClientId.description_zh: 生成备份数据的防勒索客户端的ID

Speed.description_en: The speed at which data is restored. Unit: byte/s
Speed.description_zh: 数据恢复的速度，单位为Byte/s

Status.description_en:
The status of the restoration task. Valid values:

RUNNING: The task is running.
COMPLETE: The task is complete.
FAILED: The task fails.
CANCELING: The task is being canceled.
CANCELED: The task is canceled.
PARTIAL_COMPLETE: The task is partially successful.
CREATED: The task was created but is not run.
EXPIRED: The task is not updated.
QUEUED: The task is waiting to be run.
CLIENT_DELETED: The task fails because the anti-ransomware agent is uninstalled
Status.description_zh:
数据备份的状态。 取值：

RUNNING：恢复任务执行中

COMPLETE：恢复任务已完成

FAILED：恢复任务执行失败

CANCELING：恢复任务取消中

CANCELED：恢复任务已取消

PARTIAL_COMPLETE：恢复任务部分成功

CREATED：恢复任务已创建，但尚未开始启动

EXPIRED：恢复任务未更新

QUEUED：恢复任务在等待启动中

CLIENT_DELETED：防勒索客户端已被删除，任务执行失败

Target.description_en: The folder to which the backup data is restored. After you create the restoration task, the backup data is restored to the specified folder
Target.description_zh: 备份数据存储的目标文件夹。创建恢复任务后，备份数据会恢复至该文件夹中

UpdatedTime.description_en: The timestamp when the restoration task was last updated. Unit: milliseconds
UpdatedTime.description_zh: 备份任务最后更新的时间戳，单位为毫秒

Uuid.description_en: The UUID of the server whose data you want to restore
Uuid.description_zh: 需要恢复备份数据的服务器的UUID

VaultId.description_en: The ID of the backup vault in which the backup data is stored
VaultId.description_zh: 备份数据存入的仓库的ID

VaultRegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the backup vault resides
